BOTH readings are true of DIFFERENT objects. The grading group (Z/2)^d IS the d-cube (dim = 2^d vertices; the TESSERACT at dim 16). The SIGNED UNIT SET at rung dim IS the cross-polytope beta_dim (2*dim vertices; the 16-CELL at dim 4). The one-line note is correct about the +- unit set at H and WRONG if read as a claim about the grading. The trap is that '16' names 16 CELLS in one and 16 VERTICES in the other: the 16-cell has 8 vertices, the tesseract has 16.
